rca of the issue: Timeline test failure RCA: server.py L3531-3560 builds the events list by appending 'created' (from assignment.created_at) FIRST, then status_history + job_events (to_list(200)) + time_entries (to_list(100)) + job_photos (to_list(100)), then filters/sorts desc by 'at' and truncates events[:200]. The QA-Montclair seed (id=3b2a0120-9dfb-4fe1-88cd-d5a6025ea61d) has created_at='2026-07-22T01:10...' but has accumulated >200 checklist+clock events with newer timestamps (2026-08-08...). After desc sort, 'created' is at the bottom and gets sliced off. Reproduction: GET /api/assignments/3b2a0120-9dfb-4fe1-88cd-d5a6025ea61d/timeline as owner -> response has exactly 200 events, none with kind='created'. Mitigation A: hoist the 'created' event insertion to AFTER the [:200] slice (i.e., `return {events: ([{'at': created_at, 'kind': 'created', ...}] if created_at else []) + events[:199]}`). Mitigation B: add `db.job_events.delete_many({'assignment_id': MONTCLAIR_ID, 'title': {'$regex':'^TEST'}})` + similar for time_entries to conftest._refresh_qa_seed_dates, matching the existing portal_uploads pruning.
